# Independent pre-extraction regression reference

`KaelRigPresentation90cd781.gd` is an unmodified copy of `godot/scripts/presentation/KaelRigPresentation.gd` from integration commit `90cd78195eb000d8a0fa71a631d276c1753f7e15` (SHA-256 `f039d9e7bc3d2fb0306fc335e26a60b590cd9131989219588f4244fc08cfd4f6`). It exists only to compare the new implementation against the independently reviewed original behavior using the real frozen Kael scene. Never update it to match the implementation under test. It is not a runtime dependency.
